name: Dan Winter
tagline: I design learning experiences for customer education.
headline: Customer Education · Learning Experience · Digital Design
summary: Learning experience designer with 15 years in customer education. I turn complicated material into self-paced courses, scenario-based modules, and simulations people finish. I lead learning experience and digital design at Okta, keeping a large body of learning consistent as it grows. I work with subject matter experts from needs analysis through storyboard and build so the learning stays accurate and ships on time.
heroIntro:
Hi, I’m Dan.
By day I turn confusing material into courses people get through without sighing. By night I’m finishing jigsaw puzzles and painting tiny figures. It’s the same itch both ways: figure out how the pieces fit, then make it look good.
rolesLine: Learning experience · Customer education · Digital design
